scenario: Multiple rules in the same module each get an independent RuleDebugName atom. Each template is the full RDSC.6.8.4 string for its own rule and binding, which `test_conformance.m` reads from the RuleDebugName atoms in the emitted `.dsc`. Pins per-rule independence (RDSC.6.8.8 — at most one per rule per module).
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

schema B scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule rule_a:
    A a
->
    log info "{a.entity_id}"

rule rule_b:
    B b
->
    log info "{b.entity_id}"
